body:
Application to amend zoning for 675 Conservation Dr
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
1455136 Ontario Limited Holding is proposing to create a new residential neighbourhood with 36 to 40 single-detached dwellings, a road network, parks and trails and protected environmental areas. These applications are being processed concurrently with zoning bylaw amendment application Z-17-14, draft plan of subdivision application 30T-17401 and vacant land condominium 30CDM-17409 for the adjacent lands at Beaver Creek Road and Conservation Drive.
View the concurrent application
at Beaver Creek Road and Conservation Drive.
This application was deemed complete prior to September 10 2018 when the current bylaw 2018-050 was passed.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include rezoning lands to:
Residential One (R1) Zone– permits singles. This will apply to the condominium lands. Request the removal of ‘coach house’ from list of permitted uses.
Residential Five (R5) Zone– permits singles and semis. Request to add freehold townhouse building as a permitted use on specific lands. Specific regulations for minimum lot frontages and areas, front yard encroachments and garages widths. R5 lands to be setback minimum 20 m from a sewage pumping station.
Parks and Recreation (OS1) Zone– for the parks, walkways and the two pumping stations proposed.
Conservation (OS3) Zone- for the natural features within the subdivision, as well as the associated buffers and for the stormwater management facility.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Number of units: 36 to 40
Housing types: single detached
Concurrent applications
These applications are being processed concurrently with zoning bylaw amendment application Z-17-14, draft plan of subdivision application 30T-17401 for the adjacent lands to the east.
Background information
In December 2017, these applications were appealed to the
OLT
on the basis that a decision was not made with 120 days. As these applications are the subject of active
OLT
, the review of these resubmissions and all comments issued to the applicant are without prejudice.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT).
